logic.bm: Electrification: Power Transmission (switchgear, power & distribution transformers — Prolec GE: pole-type, single/three-phase pad-mounted, network, secondary substation, collector step-up, GSU, substation & autotransformers, shunt reactors, voltage regulators), Grid Systems Integration (HVDC, AC substations), Power Conversion & Storage (synchronous condensers, converters, BESS), Grid Automation & Software. structural_breaks.note: GE에서 분사·상장. 분기 세그먼트 이력은 2023Q1부터(2024 10-Q 비교열); 2022 이전은 연간(Information Statement: 2021 5,292 / 2022 5,076 / 2023 6,378)만 공시.

Business unit realignment: Grid Solutions → Power Transmission / Grid Systems Integration / Grid Automation & Software; former Electrification Software 일부를 Power 세그먼트(Gas Power)로 이관 → 2025 Electrification 비교치 하향 재작성(Q1 2025 1,879→1,840, Q2 2,201→2,162; orders Q1 3,393→3,366, Q2 3,338→3,283). value=당해 문서, PYC=같은 문서 재작성치.

Prolec GE 잔여 50%(Xignux) 인수, 현금 $5,254M — 이전 지분법 JV(매출 미포함) → 2026-02-02부터 Electrification(Power Transmission)에 연결. 2026Q1(2/3개월)·Q2부터 매출·수주 레벨 점프(Power Transmission Q1 1,380 vs 692). YoY 해석 시 인수효과 분리 필요(보도자료 organic: Q2 2026 +29% vs reported +68%).
Proficy 제조 소프트웨어 사업(Electrification, Grid Automation & Software) 매각 완료(1Q26), 순현금 $602M.
